description:
FILED s518e (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-17) while writing lib/B.pm (#3281): `my $v = ${ $_[0]{ref} }` in the shim lost the inner reference.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs main 5c5a5679):

    my $r = [1];
    my $x = \$r;
    my %h = (ref => $x);
    my $w = ${$h{ref}}; print ref($w), "\n";          # perl ARRAY, PCL ''
    my $hr = \%h; my $w2 = ${$hr->{ref}}; print ref($w2), "\n";   # perl ARRAY, PCL ''
    print ref(${$hr->{ref}}), "\n";                   # both ARRAY
    my @a = ($x); my $z = ${ $a[0] }; print ref($z), "\n";        # perl ARRAY, PCL ''
    my $v = $$x; print ref($v), "\n";                 # both ARRAY (a plain scalar holding the ref is right)

Emission: `(p-my-= $w (p-cast-$ (p-gethash %h "ref") :rvalue))`.  The element is a RAW slot holding the is-ref value `\$r` whose referent is a box; the assignment path reads one level too deep (the array itself), so the target gets no reference.  The bare `ref(${...})` reads right.

SAME FAMILY as #3081 (ir-spec "A raw slot holds a raw value or a CONTAINER box", s514b): that ruling made a PARAMETER raw slot bind a reference-to-a-box in a fresh container; a hash value / array element raw slot read by `${ }` into an assignment is the element-side sibling.  Check the s514b fix's predicate and route the element read through it (rule 11), not a new arm.

WORKAROUND in lib/B.pm (B::SV::_value): read the ref into a plain scalar first (`my $r = $_[0]{ref}; my $v = $$r;`).


=== DONE (s520a, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) ===
Commit 2fbab21c.  The hash read twin `%p-hash-unbox-elem` keeps a box-in-box slot as its box, as `p-aref-unbox-elem` already did (the #3081 / s514b raw-slot rule, element side): `my $w = ${ $h{ref} }` with `$h{ref} = \$r`, `$r = [1]` makes `$w` the array ref (it was the array's COUNT).  The five task lines + `${ $hr->{ref} }`, `${ $a[0] }`, nested `${ ${ $h{rr} } }` and the lvalue `${ $h{ref} } = [2]` probed = perl (p3/).  lib/B.pm's B::SV::_value workaround REMOVED; Pl/t/b-shim-01.t passes and FAILS on the base with the new B.pm (the real-shape inverse guard).  Guard Pl/t/raw-slot-arg-01.t rows 7-8 (inverse FAIL).  ir-spec raw-slot paragraph.  Batch bars: session-log ## Session s520a.
subject: `my $v = ${ EXPR }` where EXPR is a hash VALUE or array ELEMENT holding a reference to a reference (`$h{k} = \$r`, `$r = []`) assigns the array, not the ref: `ref $v` is '' (perl ARRAY) -- silent wrong; `ref ${ $h{k} }` without the assignment is right
